description: List profiles, optionally filtered by email address.

email.description: Optional email address to filter profiles by (case-insensitive exact match).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of JSON:API profile resource objects (type, id, attributes); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single profile by its id.

profile_id.description: The unique id of the profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the JSON:API profile resource object; on failure (profile not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new profile with an email and optional contact/location attributes.

email.description: The email address of the profile (required, must be unique).

first_name.description: Optional first name of the profile.

last_name.description: Optional last name of the profile.

phone_number.description: Optional phone number of the profile.

organization.description: Optional organization the profile belongs to.

title.description: Optional job title of the profile.

city.description: Optional city of the profile's location.

region.description: Optional region/state of the profile's location.

country.description: Optional country of the profile's location.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created JSON:API profile resource object; on failure (missing email or duplicate profile), output contains an error message.

description: List all lists in the current Klaviyo session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of JSON:API list resource objects (type, id, attributes including name and profile_count); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List campaigns, optionally filtered by status and channel.

status.description: Optional status to filter campaigns by (e.g. 'Sent', 'Scheduled', 'Draft'; case-insensitive).

channel.description: Optional channel to filter campaigns by (e.g. 'email', 'sms'; case-insensitive).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of JSON:API campaign resource objects (type, id, attributes, relationships); on failure, output contains an error message.
